story_log.title: Ceddanne Rafaela homers for third consecutive at-bat vs Dodgers, becomes only player to hit multiple HRs off Yamamoto in a game
story_log.development: NEW: Rafaela homered three at-bats in a row per TalkinBaseball. Players to hit multiple HRs off Yoshinobu Yamamoto in a game: Rafaela today, Eric Haase in May per StatMuse. Rafaela has homered in 3 of his last 4 AB per StatMuse. Boston beat LA 2-3 per ground truth—wait, ground truth says Red Sox won 3-2. Historic power display in Dodgers loss.

story_log.title: Oba Femi defeats Brock Lesnar in Hell in a Cell at SummerSlam as Randy Orton returns to help
story_log.development: NEW: Oba Femi beat Brock Lesnar in Hell in a Cell trilogy match at SummerSlam per ESPN/SportsCenter. Randy Orton returned and hit RKO on Lesnar per SportsCenter ('OMG! RANDY ORTON IS BACK', 'THE VIPER STRIKES AGAIN'). Lesnar passed torch to Femi afterward per ESPN ('This is the past. This is the future'). CM Punk retained title at SummerSlam per ESPN. Liv Morgan retained Women's World Title over Iyo Sky per ESPN/SportsCenter. Historic passing-of-the-torch moment.

story_log.title: Sabrina Ionescu posts 27-7-10 vs Mercury, ties Caitlin Clark for second-most 25/10a games in WNBA history
story_log.development: NEW: Ionescu vs Phoenix: 27 PTS, 7 REB, 10 AST per StatMuse. Only Caitlin Clark has more 25/10a games in WNBA history per StatMuse. New York beat Phoenix 94-92 per ground truth. DeWanna Bonner had Phoenix rockin' per ESPN. Historic playmaking night for Sabrina.

story_log.title: Undrafted rookie Sydney Taylor hits game-winner for Sky to stun Aces 84-83
story_log.development: NEW: Taylor vs Las Vegas: 29 PTS, 5 3P, +10 and the game-winning three per StatMuse. Chicago beat Vegas 84-83 per ground truth. A'ja Wilson: 36 PTS, 12 REB, 2 BLK and passed Sylvia Fowles on W's all-time scoring leaderboard per StatMuse. Taylor undrafted rookie came up clutch per SportsCenter. DiJonai Carrington now 9-2 against NaLyssa Smith in their careers per StatMuse. Shocking upset by Sky.

story_log.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong drives in Nico Hoerner with go-ahead single as Cubs beat Yankees 5-2
story_log.development: NEW: PCA delivered key hit per BarstoolBigCat ('PCA just makes good things happen', 'NICOOOO'). Chicago beat New York 5-2 per ground truth. Cubs announced via Cubs account per BarstoolBigCat RT. Jazz Chisholm wanted to challenge pitch call but Yankees out of challenges, exchanged words with ump, struck out, frustrated as he left field per TalkinYanks/TalkinBaseball RT. PCA comes through again.

story_log.title: Jake Cronenworth walks off Giants for Padres
story_log.development: NEW: Cronenworth delivered walk-off hit per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. San Diego beat San Francisco 6-5 per ground truth. Padres win in walk-off fashion.

story_log.title: Max Clark hits first career MLB home run for Tigers
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Clark delivered first career homer tonight per TalkinBaseball ('MAX CLARK FIRST CAREER HOME RUN!'). Clark debuted 8/1 per history, recorded first hit and RBI double. Detroit beat Athletics 8-6 per ground truth. Osleivis Basabe tied game off Mason Miller per TalkinBaseball. Top prospect's power arrives.

story_log.title: Otto Lopez leads MLB in hits, doubles, and triples as Marlins sit third in NL East
story_log.development: NEW: Lopez this season: 1st in hits, 1st in doubles, T-1st in triples per StatMuse. Marlins third in NL East this season per StatMuse. Miami beat New York 6-2 per ground truth. Lopez quiet MVP season continues.

story_log.title: Matt Olson leads Braves in every major offensive category, has 10 HR in last 28 games
story_log.development: NEW: Olson ranks on Braves this season per StatMuse: 1st HR, 1st 2B, 1st RBI, 1st BB, 1st SLG, 1st OPS, 1st wRC+, 2nd H, 3rd OBP, 4th AVG. Has 10 HR in last 28 games per StatMuse. Atlanta beat Washington 8-3 per ground truth. Olson carrying Braves offense.

story_log.title: Jeremy Sochan signs 1-year deal with Trail Blazers after finishing 2025-26 on championship Knicks
story_log.development: NEW: Sochan agreed 1yr deal to sign with Portland per Shams. Averaged 9.9 PPG, 5.4 REB, 2.5 AST entering fifth NBA season per Shams. Finished 2025-26 on championship Knicks per Shams. Sochan joins Blazers rebuild.

story_log.title: Gary Payton II returns to Warriors on 1-year, $3.9M deal for seventh year in Bay Area
story_log.development: NEW: GP2 agreed 1yr/$3.9M deal to return to Golden State per Shams. Returns for seventh year in Bay Area, 11th NBA season per Shams. Warriors complete offseason moves.

story_log.title: Lions sign former Pro Bowl LB Devin White
story_log.development: NEW: Detroit announced signing of White per Schefter. Former Pro Bowler joins Lions defense.

story_log.title: Broncos exploring reunion with Taysom Hill after he announced departure from Saints
story_log.development: NEW: Denver will explore bringing in Hill per Sean Payton to cfrelund/wyche89 per Schefter RT. Hill announced departure from Saints per CBS Sports headline (covered 7/30 in history). Payton-Hill reunion in works.

story_log.title: Five-time All-Pro WR DeAndre Hopkins hired as assistant WR coach at Georgia Tech
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Hopkins officially hired by Georgia Tech as assistant WR coach per Schefter/ESPN story link. Coach Brent Key announced Friday per Schefter. Five-time All-Pro per ESPN. Was looking to play this season per 8/1 history. Career shift finalized.

story_log.title: Falcons sign G Matthew Bergeron to 4-year, $96M extension with $60M guaranteed
story_log.development: NEW: Atlanta and Bergeron agreed 4yr/$96M extension, $60M guaranteed per Garafolo/JFowlerESPN/Schefter RT. 38th overall pick in 2023 per Garafolo. Deal done by Chase_Callahan of excelfootball per Garafolo. Falcons lock up young guard.

story_log.title: 49ers WR Ricky Pearsall to undergo season-ending PCL surgery, will miss entire 2026 season
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Pearsall expected to undergo season-ending surgery on nagging PCL injury dating back to last season per Schefter/Lynch. Out for year, expected full recovery in time for 2027 per Schefter. 49ers officially placed Pearsall on IR per Schefter. Dealing with issue since last season per CBS Sports. Team had expressed concern on 7/30 per history. Surgery decision finalized.

story_log.title: Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson suffers lower calf strain after being carted off at practice
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Tests revealed lower calf strain per Schefter. CJGJ carted to locker room during Saturday practice per agetzenberg/FieldYates RT. SharpFootball on 8/1: 'non-contact… clutching Achilles' 4 words you never want to hear. Tests show calf strain, not Achilles.

story_log.title: Chiefs rookie WR Cyrus Allen suffers shin bruise, nothing torn or broken
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Tests on Allen revealed shin bruise per Schefter. Nothing torn or broken—best-case scenario per Schefter. Collided with Kaiir Elam as gunner on punt rep per ByNateTaylor/FieldYates RT. Left field with help per ByNateTaylor. Allen had been making marks in camp per Schefter. Dodged major injury.

story_log.title: 49ers VP Paraag Marathe departs after 25 years to focus full-time on Leeds United and Rangers FC
story_log.development: NEW: Marathe departing 49ers after 25 years to focus full-time on Leeds United and Rangers FC plus other sports efforts per Schefter/ESPN. Move in works for while, formalized today per Schefter. Led strategy and salary cap ops, key role in Levi's Stadium development per Schefter. Widely respected, forefront of many financial and front office ideas per Schefter. AlbertBreer: significant loss despite deep staff. Marathe exits for soccer.

story_log.title: Colorado judge grants extra year of eligibility to HS class of 2022, opens chaotic August transfer portal
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Judge's injunction grants fifth year to HS class 2022 per CBS Sports headline (covered 8/1). NCAA sent message to members per JonRothstein. Jaxon Kohler (Michigan State) will explore return for fifth year, receiving interest from Kansas, Kentucky, BYU per JonRothstein—return to East Lansing also possible. Averaged 12.5 PPG, 8.9 RPG last season per JonRothstein. RedditCFB: HS class 2021 lone post-2015 class to get just 4 years. William & Mary Women's Soccer Associate HC on new ruling per RedditCFB—first game vs GW in 4 days. Chaos intensifies.

story_log.title: Vincent Pastore, who played 'Big Pussy' in The Sopranos, dies at 80
story_log.development: NEW: Pastore found dead in Bronx residence Friday Aug 1 by neighbor after not being heard from for past three days per DEADLINE/BarstoolBigCat RT. Known for playing mobsters, most notably Salvatore 'Big Pussy' Bonpensiero on Sopranos per DEADLINE. 80 years old. Circumstances being investigated per DEADLINE. LeBatardShow RTd TMZ tribute. Sopranos legend passes.

story_log.title: Kevin Durant compares LeBron's 76ers to his Warriors teams: 'They have got four 25-point scorers on this team'
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 14]: KD on LeBron joining 76ers per TheNBACentel: 'Joining a team that was already built to win without you isn't real hoops... it's unfair to the league.' Then per ESPN/ClutchPoints: 'The last time they put three 20-point scorers on a team, they said it was unfair… They have FOUR 25-point scorers on this team... Hell yeah, I think they're going to be a contender.' HaterReport: 'KD still trying to justify going to 73-9 Warriors in his PRIME. He says 41-year old LeBron going to 76ers is worse.' Rich Paul per TheNBACentel: 'If LeBron brings a championship to Philly, he automatically becomes the greatest 76er to ever wear the uniform. Period.' KD keeps talking.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark posts 26-10-10 triple-double to tie Sabrina Ionescu for 3rd-most in WNBA history
story_log.development: NEW: Clark vs Portland 8/1: 26 PTS, 10 REB, 10 AST, 2 STL, 14-17 FT per StatMuse/ClutchPoints. Ties Sabrina Ionescu for third-most triple-doubles in WNBA history per StatMuse. Fever beat Fire 112-98 per ground truth. Fourth career triple-double, elite all-around performance.

story_log.title: Red Sox extend MLB's longest active win streak to 12 straight with 9-4 win over Dodgers in LA, now 21-4 in July
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 3]: Boston beat LA 9-4 on 7/31 per ground truth. Red Sox won in LA for first time since 2016 per StatMuse. Ceddanne Rafaela: 3 H (1 HR), 2 RBI, 1 SB per StatMuse—only AL player with 25+ 2B and 15+ SB this season. Win streak now at 12 (started at 11 per 7/18 history). Record this month: 21-4 per StatMuse. Historic run continues.

story_log.title: Twins acquire Dean Kremer from Orioles, now tied with Guardians for final AL Wild Card spot at 56-55
story_log.development: NEW: Minnesota acquired SP Dean Kremer from Baltimore per TalkinBaseball/JeffPassan RT. Return: Twins #24 prospect Jhomnardo Reyes per BNightengale. Twins beat Seattle 5-3 on 7/31 per ground truth (Royce Lewis tied game with homer per TalkinBaseball, Ryan Jeffers insurance homer per TalkinBaseball). Now tied with Guardians for final AL Wild Card spot at 56-55 per TalkinBaseball. Above .500 for first time since 12-11 on April 21 per TalkinBaseball. Twins adding pitching depth as they surge into playoff race.

story_log.title: Astros demolish Rangers 11-2 to reach first place in AL West for first time since April 5
story_log.development: NEW: Houston crushed Texas 11-2 on 7/31 per ground truth. Astros in first place in AL West for first time since 6-4 on April 5 per TalkinBaseball. Yordan Alvarez went 3-3 with homer and 3 RBI in earlier game per StatMuse. Astros division lead after months-long chase.

story_log.title: Giants suspend Harrison Bader's pay after he crashed scooter into fire truck at 2 AM, president of baseball operations Buster Posey says they won't pay him until he can 'resume performing services'
story_log.development: NEW: Bader reportedly injured himself driving scooter into fire truck that then ran over his already injured foot per ByRobertMurray/TalkinBaseball. Happened around 2 AM after Bader was drinking at bars per ByRobertMurray. Giants suspending payment, president of baseball operations Buster Posey says won't pay until 'resume performing services for the club' per Posey/TalkinBaseball. Bader already on IL with plantar fasciitis when further injured per CBS Sports. Out for season per TalkinBaseball. Bizarre injury, team takes action.

story_log.title: CBS Sports places Tony Romo on leave 'until further notice' following DUI arrest, JJ Watt to replace him alongside Jim Nantz
story_log.development: NEW: CBS Sports announced Romo on leave from analyst role 'until further notice' per Schefter. JJ Watt will replace Romo and work alongside Jim Nantz and Tracy Wolfson per Schefter. Romo arrested last week on suspicion of DUI per ESPN story link. Indefinite leave for top NFL analyst.

story_log.title: FIFA president Gianni Infantino scraps $20 billion private equity plan to sell World Cup stakes after UEFA and Concacaf threaten boycott
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Infantino scrapped proposal to sell stakes in World Cup after widespread backlash per ESPN/AdamSchefter RT/LeBatardShow RT. UEFA and Concacaf had voted to boycott all FIFA competitions in protest per 7/31 history. CBS Sports headline 8/1: 'FIFA scraps controversial World Cup plan: Gianni Infantino no longer seeking $20 billion investment.' Massive rift resolved, boycott threat worked.

story_log.title: Angel Reese posts 21-13 with 6 offensive rebounds to break Atlanta Dream single-season offensive rebound record
story_log.development: NEW: Reese vs Seattle: 21 PTS, 13 REB (6 OREB), 2 STL per StatMuse. Breaks franchise single-season record for offensive rebounds per StatMuse. Dream beat Storm 98-89 per ground truth. Historic rebounding season continues.

story_log.title: Shakira Austin posts 28-10 on 10-18 FG as Mystics beat Wings, has multiple 25-10 games in a season for first time in her career
story_log.development: NEW: Austin vs Dallas: 28 PTS, 10 REB, 10-18 FG per StatMuse. Multiple 25-10 games in a season for first time in career per StatMuse. Washington beat Dallas 81-75 per ground truth. Austin's breakout season.

story_log.title: Tigers promote top prospect Max Clark (#11 in baseball) for MLB debut as Tarik Skubal trade rumors fly, Clark records first hit and RBI
story_log.development: NEW: Clark promoted for debut per CBS Sports headline. #11 prospect in all of baseball heading into 2026 season per CBS Sports. First MLB hit per TalkinBaseball. RBI double off wall in debut per TalkinBaseball. Detroit beat Athletics 13-1 per ground truth. Dillon Dingler hit first career grand slam per TalkinBaseball. Tigers showcasing young talent as Skubal trade talk continues.

story_log.title: Victor Wembanyama signs new long-term Nike extension including signature shoe line after MVP finalist season, DPOY, and Finals run
story_log.development: NEW: Wembanyama signed new long-term contract extension with Nike including signature shoe line per Shams. After 3 NBA seasons: Finals run, MVP finalist, Defensive Player of Year, max deal, signature shoe per Shams. Historic shoe deal for rising star.

story_log.title: Former NFL Pro Bowl WR DeAndre Hopkins (34) joins Georgia Tech offensive coaching staff after looking to play this season
story_log.development: NEW: Hopkins (34) expected to join Georgia Tech offensive coaching staff per CBS Sports. Was looking to play in NFL this season but will be on Yellow Jackets sideline instead per CBS Sports. Surprise career shift from player to coach.

story_log.title: Packers TE Tucker Kraft activated off PUP less than nine months after ACL surgery, doctor says knee looks 'spectacular'
story_log.development: NEW: Kraft activated off PUP Friday per Schefter/RobDemovsky RT. Less than nine months after surgery to repair torn ACL in right knee per Schefter. Kraft quote: doctor 'told me my knee looks spectacular, almost like he had never seen rehabilitation like mine' per Schefter. Won't do team drills yet, will do individual and walk throughs per RobDemovsky. Remarkable recovery timeline.

story_log.title: Paul Skenes velocity way down in start vs Reds, 81 pitches through three innings with two blown leads
story_log.development: NEW: Skenes velocity way down per TalkinBaseball. 81 pitches through THREE innings with two blown leads vs 27th-ranked offense in baseball per BackAftaThis. 'barely an average major league pitcher at this point' per BackAftaThis. Cincinnati beat Pittsburgh 8-7 per ground truth (error by Jared Triolo gave Reds lead per TalkinBaseball). Concerning outing for Pirates ace.

story_log.title: Brittney Griner files for divorce from wife who fought for her release from Russia after 8 years of marriage, seeks joint custody of 2-year-old son
story_log.development: NEW: Griner filed for divorce from wife who fought for her release from Russia after 8 years of marriage per HaterReport. Seeking joint custody of their 2-year-old son per HaterReport. Shocking split given wife's advocacy during imprisonment.

story_log.title: Colorado judge grants extra year of eligibility to NCAA athletes who just graduated, opening chaotic August transfer portal window
story_log.development: NEW: Federal judge's injunction could grant fifth year of eligibility to massive amount of athletes per CBS Sports. Opens chaotic transfer portal window in August per CBS Sports. RedditCFB: 'If a group of 2021 HS seniors who finished college career 2 years ago made case they should get one more year, they'd probably win, and roster management would get even crazier.' NCAA President Charlie Baker released statement per JonRothstein. Wild eligibility ruling shakes college sports.

story_log.title: Toronto Tempo acquire Aneesah Morrow from Connecticut Sun for Maria Kliundikova rights and 2028 second-round pick ahead of Sunday deadline
story_log.development: NEW: Tempo acquired Morrow from Sun in exchange for rights to Maria Kliundikova and 2028 second-round pick per ESPN/CBS Sports. Tempo get much-needed frontcourt boost per CBS Sports. WNBA trade deadline Sunday per alexaphilippou on SportsCenter. Tempo add piece before deadline.

story_log.title: Jessica Shepard records 2 blocks vs Dallas—her first blocks of the season after 28 games without one
story_log.development: NEW: Shepard's blocks this season: 2 tonight vs Dallas, 0 in first 28 games per StatMuse. 'You can finally rest @hasjessblocked' per StatMuse. Drought over.

story_log.title: Gunnar Henderson shows rare emotion after go-ahead triple gives Orioles late lead over Phillies
story_log.development: NEW: Henderson hit go-ahead triple, showed emotion after per TalkinBaseball ('GUNNAR HENDERSON SHOWING EMOTION AFTER THIS GO-AHEAD TRIPLE'). Baltimore beat Philadelphia 6-4 per ground truth. Rare outburst from quiet star.

story_log.title: Willson Contreras avoids one pitch then takes another to the head, initially stays in but eventually exits game
story_log.development: NEW: Contreras avoided one pitch then got hit in head by another per TalkinBaseball/JomboyMedia. Initially stayed in but then exited game per TalkinBaseball. Toronto beat St. Louis 3-1 per ground truth. Scary moment for Cards catcher.

story_log.title: White Sox walk off Yankees in back-to-back games with extra-inning wins, JomboyMedia captures crying Yankees fan
story_log.development: NEW: Chicago walked off NYY 6-5 on Wednesday (7/30) per ground truth and StatMuse, marking second consecutive walk-off win over Yankees. StatMuse: 'White Sox walk off the Yankees in back-to-back games.' JomboyMedia: 'White Sox broadcast found a crying Yankees fan then kept cutting to him as his favorite team collapsed.' JayCuda: 'prior to last night's loss to the white sox the yankees had won 101 consecutive games when they had a 4+ run lead through 6 innings.' Tonight (7/31): Luis Robert Jr. breaks tie with 2-run single in 8th per TalkinBaseball. Yankees have now blown historic streak and lost 3 straight to last-place White Sox. Yankees in freefall.

story_log.title: Kody Clemens hits walk-off grand slam with Twins down to their final strike vs Royals
story_log.development: NEW: Twins trailed KC entering bottom 9th per ground truth (Royals won 3-2 in regulation). Wait—ground truth says Twins won 4-3. TalkinBaseball: 'KODY CLEMENS WALK-OFF GRAND SLAM WITH THE TWINS DOWN TO THEIR FINAL STRIKE'. trevorplouffe predicted it per TalkinBaseball RT: 'A perfect prediction from @trevorplouffe!' Twins were one strike away from loss, Clemens delivered grand slam to win it. Wild comeback finish.

story_log.title: Trade deadline approaches Monday, Passan says Tigers will trade Tarik Skubal with Dodgers as favorites
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: No new development in trade itself (Passan said Tigers will trade him, Dodgers favorites on 7/30 per history). TheRealHoz35 on PatMcAfeeShow today: 'The Detroit Tigers can't let Tarik Skubal walk out of that building and not get anything in return' and 'The Tigers still believe that they have a shot this year.. They want big league ready starting pitching and young players for Tarik Skubal.. Detroit really has to take advantage of this situation and get a big return.' Deadline is Monday Aug 3 per CBS Sports headline. No deal announced yet. Story continues, no new event.

story_log.title: Saints sign Chris Olave to 4-year, $132M extension including $90M guaranteed after career year
story_log.development: NEW: New Orleans signed Olave to 4yr/$132M extension, $90M guaranteed per Schefter/ESPN. Olave last season: 100 REC, 1,163 REC YDS, 9 REC TD per Schefter/StatMuse—top 10 in all three categories. Ohio State WR contracts over last two offseasons per Schefter: Jaxon Smith Njigba 4yr/$168.6M, Olave 4yr/$132M, Garrett Wilson 4yr/$130M, Terry McLaurin 3yr/$97M. Saints lock up second-team All-Pro receiver entering prime.

story_log.title: Deebo Samuel returns to 49ers on 1-year, $7M deal after injuries to Ricky Pearsall and Christian Kirk
story_log.development: NEW: Samuel signing 1yr/up to $7M deal with San Francisco per RapSheet/Schefter/ESPN. Former Commanders WR returns where it all began per RapSheet. Pearsall dealing with knee swelling related to PCL injury per 7/30 history (team expresses 'concern'). CBS Sports headline: 'Deebo Samuel reunites with 49ers amid injuries to wide receivers Ricky Pearsall, Christian Kirk.' BillBarnwell: Deebo YAC score rank by ESPN's receiver metrics declined from 1st/1st/1st/2nd in 2021-24 to 7th in 2025. ghetto_gronk: 'Deebo Samuel returning to the 49ers the second Ricky Pearsall got hurt.' Ihartitz: Brandon Aiyuk shows up with Deebo Samuel to 49ers training camp. Reunion driven by injuries.

story_log.title: Baker Mayfield says he feels 'disrespected' by Bucs' 2-year offer, wanted long-term commitment and $50M+ per year
story_log.development: NEW: Mayfield told ESPN Bucs offered 2-year deal, which was 'probably the most disappointing' part per FieldYates RT/JFowlerESPN. Wanted long-term commitment per JFowlerESPN. Bucs 'pretty far' from $50M+ per club, which he wanted to enter per JFowlerESPN. RapSheet on PatMcAfeeShow: 'Baker Mayfield is mad and he doesn't care who knows it.. He's gotta chip on his shoulder and he has played well in this situation before.. It feels like the Bucs are gonna try and figure everything out after this season.' AlbertBreer: Baker aware of Bucs' history of doing deals during camp, disappointed they didn't go that route. Franchise tag for 2027 projects to ~$50M per AlbertBreer. SportsCenter aired Baker's full statement. Contract standoff at camp.

story_log.title: Atlanta Falcons announce passing of Cristina Ulbrich, wife of defensive coordinator Jeff Ulbrich, after long illness
story_log.development: NEW: Cristina Ulbrich passed away Sunday after long battle with cancer per Schefter/Falcons statement. Jeff Ulbrich is Falcons DC. Falcons statement: 'heartbroken by the passing of Cristina Ulbrich, beloved wife of defensive coordinator Jeff Ulbrich, after her courageous battle with cancer. Cristina was a devoted wife, mother, and friend whose strength, grace, and resilience touched all who knew her.' Arthur Blank statement per Schefter: 'Cristina will always be an important part of our Falcons family. My heart is with Jeff, Samantha, Jax, Jace and the entire Ulbrich family during this unimaginable time.' Deeply sad news for Falcons family.

story_log.title: Mets trade A.J. Minter to Twins for Billy Amick and Bruin Agbayani as selling begins
story_log.development: NEW: Minnesota acquiring LHP reliever A.J. Minter from New York per Passan. Return: infielder Billy Amick and infielder Bruin Agbayani (son of Benny Agbayani) per Passan/WillSammon. Passan: Mets' selling starts with one of top relievers on market, many more deals to come before Aug 3. TalkinBaseball announced trade, then return. Mets wave white flag, Twins add bullpen piece.

story_log.title: A'ja Wilson posts 33-10-6 as Aces beat Liberty 104-99, first regular season win vs Stewie since 2023
story_log.development: NEW: Las Vegas beat New York 104-99 per ground truth. Wilson: 33 PTS, 10 REB, 6 AST, 2 BLK per StatMuse. First regular season win against Breanna Stewart since 2023 per StatMuse. Stewart: 26 PTS, 11 REB, 3 STL per StatMuse—passed Candace Parker for 10th all-time scoring. Jackie Young: 18 PTS in first half alone per StatMuse. Wilson with crazy and-1 bucket per ClutchPoints. Controversial possession late per ClutchPoints (Wilson lost ball, refs gave it to Aces). A'ja owns Stewie in Vegas.

story_log.title: Kamilla Cardoso drops 26-6 on 8-12 FG as Sky beat Sun 94-88, Chicago now 3-1 when she scores 25+
story_log.development: NEW: Chicago beat Connecticut 88-94 per ground truth. Wait—ground truth says Sky won 94-88. Cardoso: 26 PTS, 6 REB, 8-12 FG per StatMuse. Sky are 3-1 all-time when she scores 25+ PTS per StatMuse. Sky win on road.

story_log.title: Lynx extend win streak to nine straight with balanced attack vs Toronto, five players in double figures
story_log.development: NEW: Minnesota beat Toronto 104-72 per ground truth. Lynx double-digit scorers per StatMuse: Collier 16, Miles 16, Williams 16, McBride 13, Juhasz 12. Minnesota rolls to ninth straight win per StatMuse. Olivia Miles: 16 PTS, 3 REB, 2 STL, 0 AST (first game this season without assist) per ClutchPoints. Napheesa Collier since returning from injury per ClutchPoints: 18.3 PPG, 49 FG%, 7.0 RPG, 36 3P%, 1.3 SPG, 88 FT%, 3-0 record. Scottie Barnes in house for game per ClutchPoints. Lynx rolling, Tempo blown out.

story_log.title: Fernando Tatis Jr. robs home run at wall for Padres
story_log.development: NEW: Tatis robbed HR for San Diego per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Giants beat Padres 4-1 per ground truth. Spectacular catch, Giants still win.

story_log.title: Ronald Acuña Jr. homers for first time since May 31st as Braves beat Nationals 5-4
story_log.development: NEW: Acuña hit first homer since May 31 per TalkinBaseball. Atlanta beat Washington 5-4 per ground truth. Daylen Lile hit two homers for Nationals per ESPN. Acuña's power returns.

story_log.title: Nathaniel Lowe walks off Pirates with home run for Reds
story_log.development: NEW: Lowe walked off Pittsburgh with homer per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Cincinnati beat Pirates 3-2 per ground truth. Elly De La Cruz recorded third double of night in bottom 9th to put himself in scoring position with no outs per TalkinBaseball. JJ Wetherholt hit game-tying solo shot in 7th per TalkinBaseball. Lowe delivers walk-off.

story_log.title: Willson Contreras and Wilyer Abreu hit back-to-back homers to give Red Sox lead over Athletics
story_log.development: NEW: Contreras and Abreu went back-to-back to give Boston lead per TalkinBaseball. Red Sox beat Athletics 5-4 per ground truth. JomboyMedia: Jarren Duran mad that Contreras didn't try to score on pop fly. Boston holds off Oakland.

story_log.title: Dalton Rushing crushes 3-run homer as Dodgers jump to 5-0 lead over Mariners
story_log.development: NEW: Rushing crushed 3-run homer, Dodgers up 5-0 on Seattle per TalkinBaseball. LA beat Seattle 6-2 per ground truth. Shohei Ohtani absent from lineup with lingering left knee soreness per ESPN/TalkinBasat_TalkinBaseball. Dodgers cruise without Ohtani.

story_log.title: Mike Yastrzemski hits game-tying homer after James Wood drops ball with two outs in 9th
story_log.development: NEW: Wood dropped ball with two outs in 9th per TalkinBaseball. Yastrzemski hit game-tying homer next at-bat per TalkinBaseball. San Francisco beat San Diego 4-1 per ground truth. Costly error leads to tie, Giants win.

story_log.title: Luis García Jr. crushes long home run for Cubs
story_log.development: NEW: García sent ball a long way per TalkinBaseball. Chicago beat St. Louis 4-2 per ground truth. Cubs win.

story_log.title: Shohei Ohtani sits with lingering left knee soreness, same knee that's kept him from pitching for close to a month
story_log.development: NEW: Ohtani absent from Dodgers lineup with lingering soreness in left knee per ESPN—same knee that's kept him from pitching for close to month. Dave Roberts described decision as precautionary per ESPN. Ohtani rests as Dodgers manage injury.

story_log.title: UEFA and Concacaf vote to boycott FIFA competitions after rejecting Gianni Infantino's private equity plan to sell World Cup stakes
story_log.development: NEW: UEFA voted unanimously Thursday to boycott all FIFA competitions in protest against Infantino's plan for selling stake in World Cup revenue to private investors per ESPN. 55 UEFA members in favor per CBS Sports. Concacaf joined UEFA in rejecting FIFA's investment plan per CBS Sports headline. US Soccer Federation wrote it 'stands with Concacaf and its members' per ESPN. Infantino revealed plans earlier this week for sale of stake in FIFA Forward Enterprises that would raise $20B in exchange for influence over future World Cups per ESPN. USWNT HC Emma Hayes per SportsCenter: 'most beautiful thing about a World Cup is you want the sport to remain accessible to all.' FIFA released statement after boycott decision per ClutchPoints. Massive rift between FIFA and confederations.

story_log.title: White Sox erase 4-0 deficit with back-to-back homers and walk off Yankees 6-5 in 12th

Yankees botched pick-off in 11th to let Sox tie it. Ground truth: White Sox 6, Yankees 5. Defensive meltdown for NYY—made a kid cry per JomboyMedia. White Sox 8th walk-off win this season (2nd-most in MLB).

story_log.title: Astros reach .500 for first time since April 7, trail Rangers by one game in AL West after sweep

Astros surging at right time.

story_log.title: Sharks make Macklin Celebrini highest-paid NHL player ever: 5 years, $18.8M AAV after 115-point season

story_log.title: Atlanta Dream shoot 1-of-16 from three, come back from down 15 to beat Dallas 82-81 as Allisha Gray scores winner
story_log.development: NEW: Dream beat Wings 82-81 per ground truth. Atlanta shot 1-16 from deep per ClutchPoints/HaterReport. Down 15 at one point per ClutchPoints. Allisha Gray: 25 PTS, 8-13 FG, 9-9 FT per StatMuse—scored 13 in 4Q including game-winner per StatMuse/ClutchPoints. story_log.title: Alyssa Thomas drops 25-9-8 on 70+ FG%, becomes first player in WNBA history with those numbers twice
story_log.development: NEW: Thomas vs Golden State: 25 PTS, 9 REB, 8 AST, 10-14 FG per StatMuse. First player in WNBA history to record those numbers on 70+ FG% in multiple games per StatMuse. Phoenix beat Valkyries 91-89 per ground truth. Historic stat line for Thomas.

story_log.title: Jazz Chisholm Jr. only player in MLB with 15+ HR and 30+ SB this season
story_log.development: NEW: StatMuse: 'There is only one player this season with: 15+ HR 30+ SB That player is Jazz Chisholm Jr.' Jazz doing Jazz things.

story_log.title: Heliot Ramos posts 4 H, 3 RBI, 1 BB, 1 SB in Giants' 16-3 demolition of Brewers—first Giant with those numbers since 2008
story_log.development: NEW: Ramos vs Brewers: 4 H, 3 RBI, 1 BB, 1 SB per StatMuse. First Giant to put up those numbers in a game since 2008 per StatMuse. San Francisco crushed Milwaukee 16-3 per ground truth. Ramos' career night.

story_log.title: Eduardo Rodriguez pitches 8 shutout innings while striking out only 2 batters—first Dback to do so since 2016
story_log.development: NEW: Rodriguez vs Pirates: 8.0 IP, 5 H, 0 R, 1 BB, 2 SO per StatMuse. First Dback to pitch 8+ innings and strikeout 2 or fewer hitters in a start since 2016 per StatMuse. Arizona beat Pittsburgh 3-0 per ground truth. Soft-contact masterclass.

story_log.title: Otto Lopez leads MLB in AVG (.329), hits, multi-hit games, and 3-hit games in 420 AB this season
story_log.development: NEW: StatMuse: Lopez this season 1st in AVG, 1st in hits, 1st in multi-hit games, 1st in 3-hit games. Batting .329 in 420 AB. StatMuse: 'Highest AVG this season: .331 — Luis Arraez .329 — Otto Lopez.' Lopez quietly leading league.

story_log.title: Orioles erase 7-0 Tigers lead in 6th inning, win 10-9
story_log.development: NEW: Detroit led Baltimore 7-0 in 6th per StatMuse. Orioles came back to win 10-9 per ground truth. Tarik Skubal: 6.2 IP, 4 H, 1 ER (StatMuse said 3 ER initially, corrected), 1 BB, 6 SO, picked up 1,000th career K per StatMuse. Tigers blew huge lead.

story_log.title: Taysom Hill announces he will not return to Saints for 10th season, becomes free agent
story_log.development: NEW: Hill announced he will not return to New Orleans for 10th season per Schefter/Kat_Terrell. Saints posted tribute video narrated by Drew Brees per Schefter RT. Hill says goodbye to NOLA.

story_log.title: Bijan Robinson and Jahmyr Gibbs stage hold-ins at training camp while seeking new contracts
story_log.development: NEW: Robinson (Falcons) and Gibbs (Lions) appear to be hold-ins seeking new deals per Schefter/SportsCenter. Both expected to land extensions before 2026 season per CBS Sports headline. StatMuse comparison: Bijan 1,478 RUSH YDS, 7 RUSH TD, 820 REC YDS, 4 REC TD vs Gibbs 1,223 RUSH YDS, 13 RUSH TD, 616 REC YDS, 5 REC TD. Two elite young RBs holding leverage.

story_log.development: NEW: Cleveland and Delpit agreed 3yr/$16M per year deal, $35M guaranteed per Schefter/PatMcAfeeShow. Third NFL contract for Delpit, ties him to Browns through 2029 per Schefter. Browns now have done two DB extensions back-to-back days (Ward Monday, Delpit today) per Schefter. After trading Myles Garrett in June, longest-tenured players are now Ward and Delpit per Schefter. Browns lock down secondary.

story_log.title: Saints DT Bryan Bresee feared to have torn ACL, likely done for season
story_log.development: NEW: Bresee feared torn ACL, likely out for season per RapSheet/MikeGarafolo/Schefter RT. One of linchpins of Saints defense, rising star per RapSheet. Former first-rounder. Tests ongoing. Huge blow for New Orleans.

story_log.title: Panthers rookie WR Chris Brazzell II suffers moderate LCL tear, expected to miss up to 8 weeks
story_log.development: NEW: Brazzell suffered moderate LCL tear in left knee in practice Wednesday, expected sidelined up to 8 weeks per Schefter/CameronWolfe RT. Will get second opinion per CameronWolfe. Competing for WR3 role. NFL Week 1 is 6.5 weeks away per CameronWolfe. story_log.title: 49ers WR Ricky Pearsall dealing with knee swelling related to PCL injury, team expresses 'concern'
story_log.development: NEW: Pearsall dealing with knee swelling related to PCL injury he suffered last year per nwagoner/Schefter RT. Team says 'all options' being explored, some 'concern' per nwagoner. 49ers WR depth tested.

story_log.title: Caitlin Clark drops 32 on Seattle, Kelsey Mitchell adds 28 as Fever cruise to 105-95 win

story_log.title: Shane Bieber walks six batters in 0.2 IP for Blue Jays, first pitcher to walk 6+ while recording ≤2 outs since 2001
story_log.development: NEW: Bieber vs Nationals: 0.2 IP, 1 H, 4 ER, 6 BB (!!) per StatMuse. First pitcher to walk 6+ batters while recording 2 outs or fewer in a game since 2001 per StatMuse. First pitcher in Blue Jays history to walk 6 hitters in a single inning per StatMuse. Pitchers to walk 5+ while recording ≤2 outs since start of last season: Bieber today, Jeff Hoffman vs Dodgers in 2025 per StatMuse. Washington beat Toronto 8-6 per ground truth. Historic meltdown.

story_log.title: Reds take doubleheader from Guardians as Kyle Manzardo's grand slam caps wild first game
story_log.development: NEW: Cleveland and Cincinnati split doubleheader per ground truth (Guardians won opener 6-5, Reds won nightcap 2-0). Game 1: umps ruled Manzardo HBP which forced in run, call overturned, Manzardo hit grand slam two pitches later per JomboyMedia. Sal Stewart (Reds rookie): 2 H (1 HR), 3 RBI, 2 BB, 1 SB per StatMuse—first rookie with those numbers in a game since Ronald Acuña Jr. in 2018. Dane Myers walked off Game 1 for Reds per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints ('DANE MYERS AT THE WALL FOR THE WIN'). Wait—ground truth shows CLE won 6-5, CIN won 2-0. Myers walk-off was Game 2. Reds win nightcap, split day.

story_log.title: Eagles lock up Jalen Carter as highest-paid DT in NFL history: 4 years, $152M, $106M guaranteed
story_log.development: NEW: Philadelphia signed Carter to 4yr/$152M extension (up to $160M), $106M guaranteed per Schefter/ESPN. Makes him highest-paid defensive tackle in NFL history per Schefter. Two-time Pro Bowler. Under contract through 2031 per Schefter. Eagles secure cornerstone defender entering prime.

story_log.title: Denzel Ward becomes highest-paid DB in NFL history for second time: Browns ink CB to 2-year, $62.2M extension
story_log.development: NEW: Cleveland and Ward agreed 2yr/$62.2M deal, $52.3M guaranteed per Schefter. Makes him highest-paid DB in NFL history for SECOND time in his career per Schefter. Five-time Pro Bowler. Deal finalized before training camp practices begin. Highest-paid CBs (per-year): Ward $31.1M, McDuffie $31M, Sauce $30.1M, Stingley $30M, Horn $25M per Schefter. Browns lock down elite corner again.

story_log.title: Olivia Miles flirts with triple-double as Lynx extend win streak to eight straight with 100-93 win over Tempo
story_log.development: NEW: Miles vs Toronto: 24 PTS, 6 REB, 8 AST, 4-5 3P per StatMuse/ClutchPoints. Her fourth 20/5/5 game as a rookie, ties Breanna Stewart for 4th-most in WNBA history per StatMuse. Minnesota beat Toronto 100-93 per ground truth to extend win streak to 8 straight. Courtney Williams nutmegged defender to set up Napheesa Collier bucket per ClutchPoints. Lynx rolling, Miles leading way.

story_log.title: Draymond Green re-signs with Warriors on 1-year, $27.7M deal after opting out to give team LeBron flexibility
story_log.development: NEW: Green agreed to return to Golden State on 1yr/$27.7M deal per Shams/ESPN. Same contract he opted out of to give Warriors flexibility to pursue LeBron James per Shams. Klutch Sports CEO Rich Paul confirmed. StatMuse: 4x Champ, 1x DPOY, 2x All-NBA, 9x All-Defense, 4x All-Star. Warriors complete offseason moves per TheNBACentel. story_log.development: NEW: San Diego beat Colorado 8-7 in walk-off per ground truth/TalkinBaseball. Tatis had first five-hit game of his career per TalkinBaseball. Machado lined one in gap to tie game in 8th per TalkinBaseball (then got caught stealing third to end inning per TalkinBaseball). Bogaerts' sac fly walked it off per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Padres manager Craig Stammen ejected after disagreeing with umps twice during one Bogaerts at-bat per TalkinBaseball/JomboyMedia. Wild finish in San Diego.

story_log.title: Mariners outlast Dodgers 7-6 as Dominic Canzone's second homer gives Seattle go-ahead two-run shot
story_log.development: NEW: Seattle beat LA 7-6 per ground truth. Shohei crushed homer (23rd of season) to start game per ClutchPoints/TalkinBaseball. Cal Raleigh answered with homer to tie per TalkinBaseball. Canzone's second homer of game was go-ahead 2-run shot per TalkinBaseball. Max Muncy crushed one to give Dodgers lead earlier (joins Eric Karros with most homers in Dodger Stadium history per ClutchPoints) per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Back-and-forth slug fest, Mariners prevail.

story_log.title: Royce Lewis walks off Royals in extras for Twins
story_log.development: NEW: Minnesota beat Kansas City 3-2 per ground truth. Royce Lewis walked it off per TalkinBaseball. Twins win in extras. Byron Buxton removed from game with right hip soreness per TalkinBaseball/ChrisLongKSTP.

story_log.title: Yordan Alvarez clubs two homers including go-ahead bomb in 9th as Astros edge Angels
story_log.development: NEW: Houston beat Los Angeles 3-2 per ground truth. Yordan crushed homer in 9th to give Astros lead per TalkinBaseball. Extended MLB lead with 35th homer of season per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Yordan's power show continues.

story_log.development: NEW: Detroit crushed Baltimore 14-0 per ground truth. Blowout win for Tigers. No viral moments in feed.

story_log.title: Nationals overcome Shane Bieber's 6-walk meltdown to beat Blue Jays 8-6

story_log.title: Brewers roll past Giants 8-2
story_log.development: NEW: Milwaukee beat San Francisco 8-2 per ground truth. Brewers cruise. No viral moments in feed.

Sabrina Ionescu went crazy in 3Q (12 PTS, 3 REB, 4-6 FG) per ClutchPoints. Jonquel Jones stepped back for triple per ClutchPoints. story_log.title: Natisha Hiedeman drops career-high 33 points for Storm in loss to Fever
story_log.development: NEW: Indiana beat Seattle 105-95 per ground truth (covered Clark/Mitchell in lead story above). Hiedeman: 33 PTS (career high), 6 REB, 6 3P per StatMuse. 'Fully recovered from the All-Star 72 hour stream' per StatMuse. Hiedeman's breakout game in losing effort.

story_log.title: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak names Kirk Cousins starting QB over No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza to begin training camp
story_log.development: NEW: Kubiak announced Cousins will start over Mendoza to begin camp per Schefter/ESPN. Cousins is 'the guy' but Kubiak wants Mendoza and O'Connell to push him per MikeGarafolo. Four-time Pro Bowler gets nod. Mendoza (No. 1 overall pick) waits his turn. Raiders QB competition begins.

story_log.development: NEW: Green Bay officially placed Parsons on PUP per Schefter. Expected to miss start of season per Schefter. Probably gonna miss first month and a half, probably return Week 6 at Lambeau vs Dallas per mattschneidman on PatMcAfeeShow. Big blow for Packers defense early in year.

story_log.title: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. placed on PUP after aggravating back in mobility workout
story_log.development: NEW: Porter placed on PUP after aggravating back during mobility workout per bepryor/Schefter RT. Steelers secondary depth tested early.

story_log.title: Bears place Montez Sweat on Active/Non-Football Illness list
story_log.development: NEW: Chicago placed Sweat on Active/NFI per Schefter. Bears missing edge rusher to start camp.

story_log.title: Vikings suspend DBs coach Gerald Alexander 3 weeks following DWI arrest
story_log.development: NEW: Alexander given 3-week suspension following drunken driving arrest per Schefter/ESPN. Minnesota takes action on coach.

story_log.development: NEW: Mia Bieniemy shot Sunday night at couple's Virginia home per ESPN/Schefter. Son Elijah Zion Bieniemy (27) arrested, charged with malicious wounding, use of firearm in commission of felony, discharge of firearm inside dwelling per Loudoun County Sheriff's Office. story_log.title: Marlins end 12-game losing streak with walk-off win over Phillies in 9th
story_log.development: NEW: Miami trailed Philadelphia 7-6 entering bottom 9th. Marlins tied it in 9th per TalkinBaseball, then walked off Jhoan Duran and Phillies per TalkinBaseball. 12-game losing streak OVER per TalkinBaseball. Miami beat Philly 8-7 per ground truth. story_log.title: Mets crush Braves 14-3 as Francisco Lindor homers twice, Marcus Semien hits two bombs
story_log.development: NEW: New York destroyed Atlanta 14-3 per ground truth. Francisco Lindor homered AGAIN per TalkinBaseball to give Mets 11-run lead. Marcus Semien crushed TWO home runs per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints (second HR in 9th gave Mets lead). Mets put up 14 runs on Braves. Ronald Acuña Jr. activated from IL per CBS Sports headline (Braves continue to regain NL East lead narrative). Mets offensive explosion in rout.

story_log.title: Pirates walk off Diamondbacks in 10th as Brandon Lowe wins it
story_log.development: NEW: Pittsburgh beat Arizona 3-2 in 10 innings per ground truth. Brandon Lowe delivered walk-off hit per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Pirates win in extras.

story_log.title: Curtis Mead exits Red Sox debut after hit by pitch on hand, left wrist contusion announced
story_log.development: NEW: Mead (acquired from Nationals July 25 per TalkinBaseball) made Red Sox debut Monday night per CBS Sports headline. Hit by pitch on hand, left game per TalkinBaseball. Red Sox announced left wrist contusion per TalkinBaseball. Ceddane Rafaela hit grand slam later per TalkinBaseball/ClutchPoints. Boston beat Oakland 4-2 per ground truth. Mead's debut cut short.

story_log.title: Yankees rally from 3-0 deficit as Jazz Chisholm doubles into gap, Ben Rice delivers go-ahead single
story_log.development: NEW: Yankees trailed White Sox 3-0 entering an inning per TalkinBaseball. Jazz Chisholm roped double into gap to tie things up per TalkinBaseball. Ben Rice delivered 2-out single for Yankees lead per TalkinBaseball (Rice has 72 RBI, second in AL). Ali Sanchez hit first MLB homer to extend lead per ClutchPoints. Anthony Volpe dropped ball that would have secured win, David Bednar had to close per TalkinBaseball. New York beat Chicago 9-5 per ground truth. Cody Bellinger landed on IL with hamstring strain (4-6 weeks) per CBS Sports headline—Yankees now without Judge, Stanton, Bellinger.

story_log.title: Astros tie Angels in 9th with bases-loaded HBP, then win on bases-loaded walk
story_log.development: NEW: Houston trailed Los Angeles entering 9th. Astros tied it with bases-loaded hit-by-pitch per TalkinBaseball. Then won on bases-loaded walk per TalkinBaseball. Houston beat Angels 6-4 per ground truth. Wild finish in extras-style drama.

story_log.title: Squirrel takes over Orioles-Tigers game, entire grounds crew and Leody Taveras needed to remove it
story_log.development: NEW: Squirrel invaded field at Comerica Park per JomboyMedia/CespedesBBQ. Took entire Tigers grounds crew AND Orioles outfielder Leody Taveras to remove per JomboyMedia. Home plate umpire Bill Miller asked crowd for round of applause for grounds crew per JomboyMedia. Jason Benetti on call per awfulannouncing. BarstoolBigCat: 'What a run from the squirrel.' Baltimore beat Detroit 8-5 per ground truth. Chaos in Detroit.

story_log.title: Alejandro Kirk's bat flies out of hands, shatters dugout window
story_log.development: NEW: Kirk let go of bat and it shattered window in dugout per TalkinBaseball/JomboyMedia. Toronto beat Washington 3-2 per ground truth. Dangerous moment.

story_log.title: Two-time Pro Bowl DT Vita Vea requests trade from Buccaneers after failed contract talks
story_log.development: NEW: Vea requested trade from Tampa Bay per Schefter. Held out of minicamp seeking new contract per CBS Sports headline. Owed $17M in final year of existing deal per BillBarnwell. Barnwell estimates Dexter Lawrence ballpark ($47M over next two years) for Vea. Failed extension talks lead to trade request.

story_log.title: Colts QB Daniel Jones fully cleared from torn Achilles, ready for training camp
story_log.development: NEW: Jones said on PatMcAfeeShow he is fully cleared from torn Achilles suffered in December per MySportsUpdate/Schefter.
